preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 2 and 500,000 inclusive.
There are exactly n-1 edges provided.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid node indices between 1 and n.
The input array a has exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= n for x in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in a is between 0 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(set(x for x in a if x != 0)) == sum(1 for x in a if x != 0)
preconditions.description: Non-zero labels in a are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer modulo 10^9+7.

The output equals the number of valid final decoration configurations modulo 10^9+7, where a configuration is valid if it can be reached by some permutation of edge swaps and matches the non-zero entries in a.
